viaP2P.title: {{name}} balance isn't deposited: it's sold on the P2P
viaP2P.bodyTreasury: Turn your {{name}} balance into QUSD by taking an open offer from QvaPay's treasury (@skymind): {{howToPay}} and the amount lands in your account.
viaP2P.bodyMarket: Turn your {{name}} balance into QUSD by taking an open offer from the P2P market: {{howToPay}} and the amount lands in your account. Right now QvaPay's treasury has no open offers in {{name}}; these are the best on the market.

howToPay.ETECSA: you top up the number the offer indicates
howToPay.BANK_CUP: you transfer to the CUP card the offer indicates
howToPay.BANK_MLC: you transfer to the MLC card the offer indicates
howToPay.CLASICA: you transfer to the Clásica card the offer indicates
howToPay.BANDECPREPAGO: you transfer to the prepaid card the offer indicates
howToPay.default: you pay as the offer indicates

viaP2P.notMet: You don't meet yet: {{list}}. You can see them, but not take them for now.
viaP2P.empty: There are no open offers in {{name}} right now, neither from the treasury nor on the market. Come back in a few minutes.
viaP2P.needsP2P: To see and take these offers you need P2P access: verify your identity, your phone and your Telegram.
viaP2P.seeAll: See all offers on the P2P
